AppliesTo.description: Dimension type a symmetric part applies to (FR-TOL-02).

oneOf.description: Linear dimensions and diameters, except broken edges.
External radii and chamfer heights (broken edges).
Angular dimensions.

Cell.description: Exact decimal number as a string, e.g. "0.021", or "-" where the source defines no value.

Deviation.description: Which deviation a fundamental deviation part holds.

oneOf.description: Upper deviation (es for shafts, ES for holes).
Lower deviation (ei for shafts, EI for holes).

Feature.description: Shaft or hole, for fundamental deviations.

oneOf.description: External feature, lowercase letters.
Internal feature, uppercase letters.

applies_to.description: Dimension type, required for `symmetric` parts and absent otherwise.

columns.description: Column names, unique within the part.

deviation.description: Upper or lower, required for `fundamental_deviation` parts and absent otherwise.

feature.description: Shaft or hole, required for `fundamental_deviation` parts and absent otherwise.

id.description: Unique within the table, e.g. `linear` or `shaft_upper`.

range_of.description: Which size selects the row. Default `nominal`.

rows.description: Rows in ascending order without gaps. Each row has one value per column.

source.description: Table number or section in the source, e.g. `table 1`.

PartKind.description: What the values of a part mean.

oneOf.description:
A value `t` means the deviations `+t` and `-t`. Columns are tolerance classes.
Used by general and custom tables.
Standard tolerance grades (ISO 286). Columns are `IT01`, `IT0`, `IT1` to `IT18`.

Fundamental deviations (ISO 286). Columns are deviation letters, see the README for
the columns that depend on the grade.
The delta values for holes (ISO 286). Columns are grades `IT3` to `IT8`.

Fundamental deviations that replace the computed one for a single tolerance class in a
size range (special cases of ISO 286). Columns are tolerance classes such as `M6`.
The nominal size of the dimension.
The length of the shorter leg of an angle.

Row.description:
One row of a part: a size range and one value per column.

A range has at most one lower bound (`min_inclusive` or `min_exclusive`) and at most one
upper bound (`max_inclusive` or `max_exclusive`). "Over 30 up to and including 120" is
`min_exclusive = "30"`, `max_inclusive = "120"`. Without a lower bound the row starts above
zero; only the last row may omit the upper bound.

max_exclusive.description: Upper bound, the bound itself does not belong to the row.

max_inclusive.description: Upper bound, the bound itself belongs to the row.

min_exclusive.description: Lower bound, the bound itself does not belong to the row.

min_inclusive.description: Lower bound, the bound itself belongs to the row.

values.description: One value per column, in column order.

oneOf.description: Millimetres.

Drafted, not yet checked. Limits from draft tables carry a warning badge, and a
release build is blocked while any shipped table is a draft.
Every value checked by the owner against the printed source.

id.description:
Unique id across shipped and user tables, e.g. `iso-2768-1`. Projects reference
shipped tables by id and version.

kind.description: What the table is used for.

source.description:
Where the values come from: standard, edition and table numbers, or the company
document. Values and structure only, no text copied from the source.

standard.description: Standard number, e.g. `ISO 2768-1`. Absent for company tables.

status.description: `draft` until the owner has checked every value against the printed source (D-43).

unit.description: Unit of all size ranges. Only millimetres for now.

verified_by.description: Who verified the table. Present exactly when `status` is `verified`.

verified_date.description: When the table was verified, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Present exactly when `status` is `verified`.

version.description: Version of this table file, starting at 1. Increased with every change of a value.

oneOf.description: General tolerances by size range and class (FR-TOL-02), e.g. ISO 2768-1.
ISO system of limits and fits (FR-TOL-04), e.g. ISO 286-1.
A table written by a user or a company (FR-TOL-07), applied as a drawing rule.

ValueUnit.description: Unit of the values in a part.

oneOf.description: Millimetres.
Minutes of arc (1 degree is 60). Exact for the angular general tolerances.

part.description: The range tables that make up this table, at least one.

table.description: Identification, source and verification status of the table.
